en: Vintage sepia postcard view of a grand, tree‑lined riverside promenade in a Central European spa town. Elegant multi‑storey historicist buildings line the street on the left, while on the right is a colonnaded structure with statues on its roof, filled with strolling people in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background, more buildings climb the wooded hills. German text at the top identifies the scene as Karlsbad and specific streets or quays; publisher information appears at the bottom.
